skeptic_corrections.was: Placement only moves the flat +10 and the Active-safety term toward the Active; the HP x Energy term favours the most-charged holder. There is no holder condition to miss.
skeptic_corrections.should_be: The threat clock also depends on placement. The Active's HP always counts. A benched holder's HP counts only if the greedy victim loop reaches that Pokemon before the opponent has 3 points. Extra HP on a benched Pokemon ex can also move it earlier in that loop and SHORTEN the clock, at -100 per turn. So the clock pulls toward the Active as well, and a benched Cape can score below zero. The same applies to Leaf Cape and Elegant Cape. Example: the opponent has 0 points, the threat hits for 100, and the Active is a 1-point Pokemon. The Bench holds an ex X at 110 HP (key 55,000) and a 1-point Y at 60 HP (key 60,000). Without the Cape the loop takes Y (1 turn) and then X (2 turns), 3 turns. With the Cape, X has 130 HP (key 65,000) and is taken first (2 turns), which reaches 3 points and stops: 2 turns. That is -100 against +20 x (E+1), so the Cape nets negative for E <= 3.

tools: Every Tool gets the same flat +10 when it sits on the bot's Active, and every card leaving the hand costs 1. So a Tool on a Tool-free Active nets +9 whatever it does, and on the Bench it nets -1 plus whatever its effect adds. Only the HP Capes add anything on the Bench. Evidence: engine/src/players/value_functions.rs:31, 50, 510, 516, 588, 601, 667-672 (reads has_tool_attached, engine/src/state/played_card.rs:336-338). This fits the audit: all 13 Tools are played in 0.83-0.99 of the games where they could be, and almost all attachments go to the Active (useless_tools.txt, the Active column at attach).

Effects that happen on the opponent's turn are invisible. kp3 searches no opponent actions (engine/src/players/mod.rs:502-511, opponent_ply 0) and scores the position at the turn boundary (engine/src/players/expectiminimax_player.rs:773-798, 914-917). kp3's value function has no defender damage modifiers either (value_functions.rs:176-187 + 421-431, EvalFeatures::OFF; kd has them at 216-228 via hooks/core.rs:1583-1644). This covers Rocky Helmet, Poison Barb, Heavy Helmet, Metal Core Barrier, the -10 and immunity of Steel Apron, Protective Poncho and Lucky Egg.

What the score does see of Tools: HP (Giant, Leaf and Elegant Cape through get_effective_total_hp, played_card.rs:290-310, read by the Pokémon value term at value_functions.rs:1137-1150, Active safety at 1633-1642, and the clock at 903-950); the Active's Retreat Cost (Small Balloon and Inflatable Boat, hooks/retreat.rs:136-146 read at value_functions.rs:640-664, Active only, 1 point per Energy); and end-of-own-turn effects when the search line reaches EndTurn or an attack (Deceptive Needle, hooks/core.rs:571, 580-603, run from the EndTurn forecast at actions/apply_action_helpers.rs:47-112).

The flat +10 never checks the Tool's condition on its holder. The engine gates each effect by holder (hooks/core.rs:584-587, 703-713, 728-733, 754-761; played_card.rs:296-301; hooks/retreat.rs:136-146; the comment at tools.rs:125-128 says the same), but the bonus reads only whether any Tool is attached. So every conditional Tool scores +9 on an ineligible Active. That is exactly the waste in useless_tools.txt: Small Balloon on Espeon, Igglybuff and Mega Altaria ex; Heavy Helmet on Glimmora and Indeedee ex; Elegant Cape on Basics; Metal Core Barrier and Steel Apron on Indeedee ex; Deceptive Needle on Happiny. Protective Poncho is the extreme case: the only slot the score rewards is the one slot where it never works.

A Tool uses 2 of kp3's 3 search actions. Playing it pushes a separate choice of holder (actions/apply_trainer_action.rs:1888-1902; move_generation/move_generation_trainer.rs:387-396), and choosing the holder spends a ply like any own action (expectiminimax_player.rs:940-960). So only one action fits after the attach. An end-of-turn effect (Needle) is seen only when that action is an attack or EndTurn (an attack's forced end of turn is resolved without a ply, expectiminimax_player.rs:633-657); lines that stop at depth 0 on the bot's own turn are scored statically (800-905).

Public pricing (the only difference between kp3 and k3) touches exactly one Tool in this group, Lucky Egg. Its text has both 'opponent' and 'hand', so k3's text rule leaves its Play unpriced (observation.rs:444-485) and scores it as the position before playing it (expectiminimax_player.rs:441-453). kp3 audits the text (public_pricing_player.rs:57) and prices it like any Tool, which only adds the flat +10; the draw stays invisible. No other Tool text here mentions the opponent's hand or deck, so for those kp3 plays exactly as k3.

The only place kp3 looks at the opponent's next attack is the public-reply loss certificate, and it refuses any board with a Tool other than Giant Cape (players/public_reply.rs:604-610, 673-683). It also refuses any search line that contains a Tool play, because only X Speed, Retreat, EndTurn and Attack keep the line eligible (public_reply.rs:233-260). So a defensive Tool never gets credit for surviving a lethal hit. The flip side is bigger: a line that plays any Tool (or attaches Energy, or anything else outside that list) can never be scored as a proven loss. Giant Cape's +20 HP is modeled there, but only for a Cape attached before the current decision.

The opponent's Tools are seen; the bot's own are not. When kp3 attacks into an opponent's Active holding Heavy Helmet, Metal Core Barrier, Steel Apron or Rocky Helmet, or snipes a Poncho-wearing Benched Pokémon, the damage change and the back-damage happen inside kp3's own turn (hooks/core.rs:1647+ modify_damage, 1707-1715; actions/apply_action_helpers.rs:595-602), so they are priced. The same card is invisible to kp3 when it holds it itself. The difference is purely timing.

Per-turn play rates understate how often Tools get played. Per game it is 0.83-0.99 for every Tool. Per-turn rates are diluted by second copies and by turns when only Bench slots were free (the Active already had a Tool), where a Tool whose effect the score can't see is worth -1. The lowest per-turn rates are all in decks with 2-3 Tool kinds sharing one Active: brew-03a Poison Barb 0.452 (with Giant Cape and Rocky Helmet), Lucky Egg 0.516-0.565 (with Giant Cape), Suicune's Inflatable Boat 0.639 (with Giant Cape).

Outside the Tool group, on the relayed report that Rare Candy can't be used on the Active against Aerodactyl ex: the engine does allow it. lib/card.py gives Primeval Law as 'Your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Active Pokémon.' The engine enforces that only for ordinary evolution (engine/src/move_generation/mod.rs:252-258, can_evolve_at_position; lookup at 270-282). Rare Candy's legality check (move_generation/move_generation_trainer.rs:663-685) looks only at Malamar's NoEvolutionFromHand (move_generation/mod.rs:263-268). Its resolution (actions/apply_trainer_action.rs:1905-1928) offers every Basic in play, the Active (slot 0) included, with no Primeval Law check. This is an engine rules bug, not a kp3 scoring issue; the repo is read-only here, so it is flagged, not fixed.
supporters: Every Supporter effect that lasts into the opponent's turn is invisible or only proxied. kp3's search stops at the end of its own turn (opponent_ply 0: expectiminimax_player.rs:97-108, 773-797, 914-918). The value function has no TurnEffect term at all (none appears in value_functions.rs), and it reads no Special Condition: the status-clock code at value_functions.rs:881-892 is behind a feature that is off by default (engine/Cargo.toml:31-38), and the official build uses default features (rl/engine-2026-09-25/README.md:23). Results: Cheren and Jasmine count as a lost card; Master Plan's lasting confusion, Pokemon Center Lady's lasting cure and Mars's disruption are not seen; Guzma misses Tools that act on the opponent's turn.

Effects that pay off within the bot's own turn are fully priced by the search itself: damage bonuses (Red, Cynthia, Korrina, Clemont's Backpack via Clemont), Iris's extra point, Will's forced heads, gusts (Sabrina, Cyrus), Psychic's Energy move and Wally's attach. The condition is that the payoff fits in the plies left. kp3 gets 3 own actions per decision (players/mod.rs:502-512, max_depth 3; the root gets max_depth-1 at expectiminimax_player.rs:323; each own action costs 1 at :950), and the Supporter uses one of them. None of these cards has a low rate caused by a blind spot: Iris 6%, Cynthia 24%, Red 23-33%, Korrina 34% and Wally 50% are turns where the bonus has nothing to act on.

Supporters that open a choice (heal target for Erika, Lillie and Pokemon Center Lady; switch target for Cyrus; Psychic's source; Wally's target; Ilima's target; Team Rocket's Boss's selection) spend a second ply on that choice (expectiminimax_player.rs:940-969). Played as the last ply, the choice is still pending when the leaf is scored at depth 0 (:800-906), so the card counts as lost with no effect. For Sabrina, the opponent's choice is also a ply, and the search assumes their worst-for-the-bot pick (:970-1020). Irida, Guzma, Mars, the draws and the deck searches resolve inline and use no extra ply.

Hand and deck counting is what prices the draw and disruption Supporters: score += (own hand - opponent's hand) x1 + (opponent's deck - own deck) x1 (value_functions.rs:510-511, 588-589). A card drawn is +2, a card played is -1 (the Supporter is discarded from hand at apply_action_helpers.rs:990-991), and each card moved from the opponent's hand to their deck is +2.
